summary: Strong script with proper bash conventions (set -euo pipefail, quoted vars, clear die() handler) and excellent YAML practices (pinned refs, least-privilege perms, sensible triggers). However: (1) workflow has duplicated jq installation logic (lines 35-40 and 75-80) should factor into composite action; (2) no explicit shellcheck/bash -n validation steps despite task requirements; (3) fixture files/bats tests not shown (task says no tests, but TDD and act validation thoroughness unclear). Matrix logic sound and jq delegation appropriate, but complex jq programs are maintenance risk without deeper comments.
